name: smwgraphics-jikkyou-oshaberi-parodius-psx-sweet-land
title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - Sweet Land
description:
Originally, I wanted to release the BG at the next C3, but I don't have much planned, so I'll release it now. This realistic BG is seen in stage 5 of the PSX game where you'll fight Decoration Core MK II, a handdrawn sprite, at the end. Separated the BG and the gradient, ripped the BG with Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature after editing the BG and added the gradient using EffecTool. Even thought the back area color is included in the BG editor, you can edit it as you please. Uses the 2nd half of palettes 4 and 6. The HDMA is included in the archive.

Update: Moved FG2 tiles to BG2.
